target: Bridge existing dNh CRM RDCP proof, source-ledger, review-sensor, and Task Orchestrator projection artifacts into the accepted PCP planner contract without modifying dNh CRM.
invariants: Risk lane is L2 because RDCP authority and freshness semantics cross a repository boundary.
TP-DMX-PCP-PLANNER-FOUNDATION-001 must be accepted before activation.
DDD-Enterprises/dNh-CRM is read-only under this packet.
Existing RDCP artifacts are consumed, not replaced or reinterpreted into stronger claims.
Task Orchestrator projections remain authority NONE and is_proof false.
No gov accept, CRM write, GitHub write, runtime service, or Task Orchestrator write tool may be called.

execution.stacked_because: Consumes the accepted foundation protocol and can run independently of the AdOps adapter in a separate worktree.

pr.title: feat(pcp): bridge existing dNh RDCP evidence
pr.body: Consumes pinned, source-backed RDCP artifacts through an additive dNh extension. dNh CRM remains read-only and Task Orchestrator remains non-authoritative. L2 final independent audit required.

steps.task: Replace the illustrative dNh fixture with a source-backed snapshot pinned to dNh CRM commit 92eb632bb07426ae5159c02bf9da549888e7caf1.
requirements: Capture explicit blobs for AGENTS.md, ACTIVE.md, RDCP architecture, proof-pointer schema and artifact, source ledger, review-sensor output, and Task Orchestrator RDCP export.
Record Git blob SHA, SHA-256, source URL, fetched_at, privacy class, and redaction notes in SOURCES.json.
Remove or quarantine sha256:PLACEHOLDER-illustrative-not-computed from the production fixture path.
Do not copy runtime databases, client records, raw messages, tokens, or local absolute paths.
validation: All material fixture claims resolve to the pinned dNh commit.
The fixture contains no illustrative placeholder identity or sensitive client data.

steps.task: Reconcile the existing dNh extension manifest with observed RDCP artifact contracts.
requirements: Keep extension_kind DNH_CRM and all five additive invariants true.
Map RDCP proof pointers, source ledger, review sensor, evidence bundle, and Task Orchestrator artifact-only export explicitly.
Preserve freshness states CURRENT, STALE, MISSING, UNREADABLE, UNPARSEABLE, MIXED_SHA, and UNKNOWN without collapsing them.
Do not map Task Orchestrator output as proof or acceptance.
validation: Extension manifest validates against PCP Core.
Every RDCP mapping names an observed dNh path and expected schema version.

steps.task: Implement and register the dNh RDCP adapter against the frozen foundation protocol.
requirements: Implement DnhRdcpExtensionAdapter.enrich(generic_export: Mapping[str, object], source_root: Path) -> SourceSnapshot.
Validate proof-pointer and manifest bytes before mapping claims.
MIXED_SHA, malformed schema, path escape, stale proof, missing auditor identity, and source disagreement must fail closed.
One malformed RDCP lane must not erase other dNh or portfolio lanes.
validation: Adapter preserves RDCP status and provenance without inventing readiness.
Generic PCP behavior and DCP extension behavior remain unchanged.
Tests prove dNh CRM and Task Orchestrator write functions are never invoked.

steps.task: Freeze the exact content head and complete one independent L2 audit.
requirements: Audit RDCP fidelity, source isolation, freshness preservation, PCP non-regression, and dNh/Task Orchestrator inertness.
Any audit mismatch or non-passing verdict blocks readiness.
validation: Proof binds the exact head and confirms dNh CRM was not mutated.
PR remains unmerged pending Control Tower disposition.
